messages.text: Map the chain from a AI market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Oscilloscope.

| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Oscilloscope capability |
|---|---|---|
| AI-server trends push PCB toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission.[24] | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance.[17] | The oscilloscope must support high-speed electrical interface testing, because the source maps “Interface Test” for high-speed electrical-interface validation to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices.[17] |
| AI-server PCB upgrades require low-dielectric, low-loss, and high-thermal-dissipation designs in materials such as M8 CCL and HVLP copper foil.[24] | Signal-integrity validation parameters include IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance.[17] | The oscilloscope must support SI validation around interface behavior, especially eye-diagram-related interface testing, because the source lists eye diagram in the high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow and maps interface test to scopes.[17] |
| AI-server mainboards are described as reaching 30–40 layers and needing 12–14× aspect ratio while addressing thick copper and laser drilling process challenges.[24] | TDR impedance is listed as part of the high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow.[17] | The oscilloscope must be usable in the high-speed PCB/PCBA validation workflow where TDR impedance is a measured SI item and scopes are mapped to electrical interface testing.[17] |
| AI/data-center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect as part of a broader data-center connectivity portfolio.[13] | The validation challenge for high-speed electrical interfaces includes Tx, Rx, channel, packages, PCBs, connectors, equalization, ADC/DSP, and DAC blocks.[17] | The oscilloscope must support validation of high-speed electrical interface paths, because the source connects the “Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces” block to scopes among the required instrument types.[17] |
| AI/data-center infrastructure emphasizes connectivity, power, and resilience as visible focus areas.[14] | Power Distribution Network is a listed test/validation block.[17] | The oscilloscope must also support PDN-related measurements, because the source maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers.[17] |
【推論】A supported chain is: AI-server demand for high-speed PCB transmission → SI parameters such as IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance → oscilloscope capability for high-speed electrical interface validation.[24][17]

R&S AI Workplace
[[R&S AI Workplace]] 是 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_ScriptAssist]] 與 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 中作為所有 AIW Assists 共同基礎需求的 AI workplace 產品 / 方案名稱；[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 另從 customer discovery 角度補充其與 virtual testing、AI-assisted / agentic test workflows 與工具整合需求的關係。

R&S AI Workplace Solutions › Customer questionnaire 語境
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 說明問卷問題用於理解客戶在 virtual testing 與 AI-assisted, agentic test workflows 方面的 needs and constraints，包含：

- 如何 create tests、analyze results、integrate tools into engineering environment。
- 客戶現有 workflow pain：scripting、environment setup、debugging failures、documentation。
- AI and tooling readiness：IDE agents、CI bots、internal automation、data residency、air-gapped labs、cloud / LLM use approval。
- IP and test content handling：fully on-prem、hybrid 或 cloud-acceptable for certain tasks。
- Integration ecosystem：instruments、software、CI、issue trackers，以及 [[Orchestration layer]] 要插入的地方。
- Outcomes：time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations。
- Adoption risks：technical、organizational、compliance blockers，以及 vendor 需提供的 training、reference architectures、security documentation 或 hands-on support for a pilot。
- Tools & AI harness：[[Claude Code]]、[[Cursor]] 或 similar tools、licenses、approval flow、guardrails、test automation use cases 與 [[Customer agent harness]]。

TechAssist
[[TechAssist]] 是 [[R&S AI Workplace]] 的 on-prem AIW Assist 之一；[[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 說明其部署前需要的 base AI Workplace 條件、Workstation / Mac 硬體條件與必要時的 [[CMX Access]]。

[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 則不是 prerequisites，而是問卷。它用於了解客戶 around virtual testing and AI-assisted, agentic test workflows 的 needs and constraints，包含如何 create tests、analyze results、integrate tools into engineering environment。

這是不同 AIW Assist 的 product-specific requirement 差異，不視為矛盾。

LTM TTCN-3 Test cases- ss stack Requirements Analysis › 重點摘要
本來源是 Rohde & Schwarz confidential 文件《LTM TTCN-3 Test Cases - SS Stack Requirements Analysis (IWD_26wk24)》，標示 Generated: 2026-06-26，Source: IWD_26wk24 TTCN-3 codebase，整理 [[L1-L2 Triggered Mobility]]（LTM）TTCN-3 test cases 對 [[SS Stack LTM Requirements]] 的能力需求。來源列出 Total LTM Test Cases: 17，涵蓋 [[RACH-based LTM]]、[[RACH-less LTM]]、[[NR-DC]] LTM、[[Carrier Aggregation]] LTM，以及 [[RLC]] / [[PDCP]] persistence、NoResetID、DRX、CFRA、T304、LBT failure 等測試子集合。

來源不是 3GPP 標準全文，而是從 TTCN-3 codebase 反推出的 test implementation requirements；因此其中的 API / template 名稱（例如 `cas_NR_MacCommandTrigger_REQ`、`cs_LTM_CellSwitch_CE`、`f_NR_SS_ConfigLTM_TCI`）應視為 SS stack / test harness 需求，不可直接推論為 [[3GPP TS 38.321]]、[[3GPP TS 38.331]] 或 [[3GPP TS 38.508-1]] 的正式條文內容。

answer.text:
| AI market requirement | Measurable parameter | Required Oscilloscope capability |
|---|---|---|
| AI-server trends push PCB toward higher layer count, larger area, and high-speed transmission.[24] | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance.[17] | The oscilloscope must support high-speed electrical interface testing, because the source maps “Interface Test” for high-speed electrical-interface validation to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices.[17] |
| AI-server PCB upgrades require low-dielectric, low-loss, and high-thermal-dissipation designs in materials such as M8 CCL and HVLP copper foil.[24] | Signal-integrity validation parameters include IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance.[17] | The oscilloscope must support SI validation around interface behavior, especially eye-diagram-related interface testing, because the source lists eye diagram in the high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow and maps interface test to scopes.[17] |
| AI-server mainboards are described as reaching 30–40 layers and needing 12–14× aspect ratio while addressing thick copper and laser drilling process challenges.[24] | TDR impedance is listed as part of the high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow.[17] | The oscilloscope must be usable in the high-speed PCB/PCBA validation workflow where TDR impedance is a measured SI item and scopes are mapped to electrical interface testing.[17] |
| AI/data-center connectivity includes high-speed electrical interconnect as part of a broader data-center connectivity portfolio.[13] | The validation challenge for high-speed electrical interfaces includes Tx, Rx, channel, packages, PCBs, connectors, equalization, ADC/DSP, and DAC blocks.[17] | The oscilloscope must support validation of high-speed electrical interface paths, because the source connects the “Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces” block to scopes among the required instrument types.[17] |
| AI/data-center infrastructure emphasizes connectivity, power, and resilience as visible focus areas.[14] | Power Distribution Network is a listed test/validation block.[17] | The oscilloscope must also support PDN-related measurements, because the source maps Power Distribution Network testing to scopes and network analyzers.[17] |
【推論】A supported chain is: AI-server demand for high-speed PCB transmission → SI parameters such as IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance → oscilloscope capability for high-speed electrical interface validation.[24][17]

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

AI 資料中心基礎設施 › 可追溯範圍
本頁根據五張圖像來源建立：[[0. AI Data Center image 1]]、[[0. AI Data Center image 2]]、[[0. AI Data Center image 3]]、[[0. AI Data Center image]] 與 [[4 AI Data Center Eco-Chain image 1]]。

- [[0. AI Data Center image 1]] 可追溯的主張限於：AI / data center 場景與 **Enabling AI**、[[Connectivity]]、[[Power]]、[[Resilience]] 的視覺關聯。
- [[0. AI Data Center image 2]] 可追溯的主張限於：資料中心 / 機房 solution diagram 中列出的子系統分類與 1–11 編號設備 / 系統名稱。
- [[0. AI Data Center image 3]] 可追溯的主張限於：**Enabling AI** 與資料中心 / 機房 / 基礎設施場景的視覺關聯，以及 [[Connectivity]]、[[Power]]、[[Resilience]] 三個明示重點方塊。
- [[0. AI Data Center image]] 可追溯的主張限於：資料中心 / 機房 solution diagram 中列出的子系統分類、1–11 編號設備 / 系統名稱，以及「2 or 3」共同標示造成的位置未決問題。
- [[4 AI Data Center Eco-Chain image 1]] 可追溯的主張限於：12/10/2025（日期格式未標示）頁面上的 ecosystem map 分類、公司 / 品牌 / logo 列名、頁尾 Rohde & Schwarz / COMPANY RESTRICT / RS / 頁碼 25 等可見資訊。
- 由於前四份來源都未標示日期，所有與時序、市場現況、供應商名單、產品導入、客戶採用、出貨量或市場占比相關的判斷都需要其他來源補強。
- 即使 [[4 AI Data Center Eco-Chain image 1]] 有頁尾日期 12/10/2025，它仍未提供市場數值、排名、關係線或採用狀態，因此不能單獨支持市場份額、導入狀態、供應鏈上下游關係或 R&S 往來關係。

SerDes 與 SI PI 測試概覽 › 來源中的說法
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）封面標題為 **What is Serdes and SI/PI?**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）把 R&S Group div 1 targets 寫成 **Digital**、**Power**、**RF**。
- [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（2026.3.4）在 Slide 11 以 **Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces** 描述高速電性介面的驗證挑戰。
- Slide 11 的資料路徑示意包含 Tx、Rx、Channel、Tx Package、PCBs、Connectors、Rx Package、EQ (FFE)、EQ (CTLE, DFE)、ADC + DSP、DSP + DAC 等圖上文字。
- Slide 11 將測試 / 驗證區塊連到儀器類型：Interface Test 對應 scopes、BERTs、AWGs、switch matrices；RefClk and PLL jitter performance 對應 phase noise analyzers 與 signal generators；[[Power Distribution Network]] 對應 scopes 與 network analyzers；ADC / DAC frontend performance 對應 spectrum analyzers 與 signal generators。
- Slide 20 題為 **Signal integrity flow of high speed PCB/PCBA**，列出 [[IL]] / [[Xtalk]] / [[Eye diagram]]、[[TDR Impedance]]、[[Stackup Planner]]、[[TL Calculator]]。

AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級 › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）標題為「PCB供應鏈升級重點」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 AI伺服器趨勢推升 [[PCB]] 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸，供應鏈全面翻新。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[AWS Trainium 2 Max]]、[[Google TPU V6]]、[[Meta MTIA 2]] 量產，並稱 2026年新平台將陸續推出。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[HVLP銅箔]] 進入第4、5代，[[CCL]] 以 [[M8]] 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱主板層數達 30～40 層，縱深比需達 12～14 倍，並需應對厚銅、雷射鑽孔等高階製程。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 TPCA Show 焦點聚焦玻纖布、HVLP銅箔、CCL 發展與高縱深比設備，反映材料與製程全面升級。
- [[HSD PCB image 1]]（來源發布日期未標示；取得於 2026-09-04）以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，比較 [[GB200]] NVL72(72GPU)、[[GB300]] NVL72(72GPU) 與 [[VR200]] NVL144(72GPU) 的時間、製程、功耗、載板、CCL 材料、上游材料、ComputeTray、NVSwitch Tray、CPX 與 Midplane。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）與 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 高度重疊，同樣以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，右上角標示「資料來源：產業調研、福邦投顧整理」。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB200]] / [[GB300]] ComputeTray 為 **5層22L**，[[VR200]] ComputeTray 為 **6層26L**；[[GB200]] / [[GB300]] NVSwitch Tray 為 **24L HLC**，[[VR200]] NVSwitch Tray 為 **32L (N+N HLC)**，[[VR200]] Midplane 為 **44L(N+N HLC)**。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB300]] 使用 **HVLP3銅箔**，[[VR200]] 使用 **HVLP4銅箔**，並將 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料列為 **M8(LDK2+HVLP4) 生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)**。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[VR200]] ComputeTray PCB 供應商 / 占比為 **欣興35~40% > 臻鼎25~30% = 勝宏25~30%**。

⚠️ [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）說 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料供應為「生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)」，但既有頁面 [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 說 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 的對應欄位為「生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最長)」。判斷：最快 / 最長方向相反，影響對 [[南亞]] 供應鏈定位的解讀；在回看原圖前不得擇一。
